text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — opened PR to modernize the Troubleshooting/Error Reference section (429s, timeouts, context limits). Need migration review + new SDK snippets (Python/Go/JS). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
Mike: Which SDK versions should the snippets target?
Anya: Target SDK >= 2.1.0. Keep the old examples behind a "legacy" callout for one release cycle (30 days) so integrators aren't broken.
Oliver: I can port Python samples. CI already flagged one example failing lint in examples/429_retry.md
docs-bot: CI: docs/examples check failed — example_test.py:42 TimeoutError when running example harness (see logs: https://ci.internal/1234) :warning:
Sara: I'll reword the context-limit guidance to call out automatic prefix trimming + show helper. Proposed helper:
```python
def trim_prompt(prompt, max_tokens=3000):
    # simple suffix-trim strategy for example
    while tokens(prompt) > max_tokens:
        prompt = prompt.split('\n', 1)[-1]
    return prompt
```
Mike: OK — I'll add equivalent snippet in JS and a tiny e2e that fakes a 429 then asserts fallback_model used.
Luis: We should also add a short migration note in SDK CHANGELOG and create a redirect from /docs/429 -> /docs/errors/rate-limits to avoid 404s.
Anya: Good call, Luis. Also need an integration test that exercises fallback behavior (simulate 429), maybe use recorded responses so CI doesn't call prod. @Mike can you add?
Mike: Yep — will add a recorded cassette and a smoke test under tests/e2e/test_fallback.py. Pushing branch now.
Oliver: Python snippets ported and updated to the new client.retry() API. Left a TODO for batch-requests example.
Anya: Assigning reviewers: @Sara for content wording, @Mike for test/code. Target merge by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Sara: Small wording nit in the 'graceful degradation' paragraph — replace "attempts a fallback" with "falls back to compatible model variant". Otherwise LGTM.
Mike: Fixed nit, pushed. CI is green :tada:
docs-bot: Merge scheduled by automation. Will deploy docs to staging tomorrow at 03:00 UTC.
Anya: Thanks all. I'll add the legacy note and the redirect after merge. Closing out this thread.
